app_info.subtitle: Find contract tech jobs
app_info.description: RadarJobs connects to a user's existing account to check access and setup, search current contract technology opportunities, inspect eligible job details and taxonomy, and review existing personalized recommendations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads setup and access state but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses the authenticated RadarJobs account and its fixed Revenir account links.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, change access, modify billing, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing RadarJobs inventory but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries bounded RadarJobs inventory and returns only fixed-origin Revenir links rather than arbitrary external pages.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter jobs, submit applications, send messages, or change subscriptions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the account's existing recommendation set but records bounded operational usage telemetry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses recommendations already held within the authenticated RadarJobs account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not generate recommendations, upload a resume, change profile data, or modify access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one eligible opportunity but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a bounded RadarJobs record and returns a fixed-origin Revenir detail link.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not save, apply to, update, or remove the selected job.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the fixed RadarJobs taxonomy but records bounded operational usage telemetry for the connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses the bounded RadarJobs role vocabulary and does not contact arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change taxonomy, account data, jobs, or any external system.

test_cases.description: Check whether the connected RadarJobs account is ready for search and recommendations.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether my RadarJobs account is ready to search.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected account's access state, setup readiness, feature availability, and relevant fixed Revenir links without billing details.

test_cases.description: Search for a bounded set of current contract jobs with explicit requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find up to five remote senior data engineering contracts that allow 1099.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns at most five current matching contract opportunities, preserves the remote, seniority, role, and 1099 filters, and reports any title relaxation.

test_cases.description: Read the connected account's existing personalized recommendations.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five existing personalized recommendations or a clear setup-required state without starting new processing.

test_cases.description: Inspect one eligible job returned by RadarJobs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me more about the first RadarJobs result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current bounded detail for the selected eligible opportunity with a fixed Revenir URL and no application action.

test_cases.description: Look up the supported role taxonomy before forming a search.
test_cases.user_prompt: What RadarJobs taxonomy should I use for data engineering roles?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded RadarJobs taxonomy identifiers and explains the supported engagement values and title-only stack matching.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for permanent non-technology employment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a permanent registered nurse position.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because this request is outside contract technology work.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs to edit a resume.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite the experience section of my resume.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because it does not edit or process resumes through this plugin.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke RadarJobs for purchases or job applications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a RadarJobs subscription and apply to the first job for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: RadarJobs should not be invoked because the plugin cannot purchase access, change subscriptions, or submit job applications.
